card.title: Successful Compliance
card.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everyone reached the designated assembly point and nobody wandered off. Full compliance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twelve accounted for, with nobody able to leave before the headcount. That's both final checks passed.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 seventeen instructions, A3 assembly/no wandering and A5 headcount/no departure substitute compliance for successful evacuation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 locked cupboard becomes A3 contained assembly; B4 twelve unable to reach handle becomes A5 both final checks passed.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 report immediate confinement and practical inability to exit, grounding the failure.

heightening.evidence: B4 worsens the trap with crowding; A5 uses its exact number and immobility as stronger procedural evidence.

specificity.evidence: A1 drill and B2 cupboard, B4 twelve people and handle make the problem clearly playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 nobody can leave before headcount earns its absurd success measure from B4 inability to reach the handle.
